notes.title: Our Life: Now & Forever Public Demo Update November 2024
notes.notes:
The Our Life: Now & Forever Step 2 introduction scenes are live 🎉🎉🎉

It includes 27,000 new words, two new CGs, and various fixes/tweaks throughout the demo. We’re actually working on Step 2 at this point, Step 1 is basically done, so this is as it should be instead of the bonus preview that we had in the demo as an example of the teenage time period. However, right now that original Step 2 preview is not accessible in this build. The preview had skipped ahead in the story and included some explanatory lines that need to be removed now that the proper opening is available. We are working on editing/reprogramming the original preview to properly flow with the rest of the story. It should be added back next month!

You can access Step 2 from the Moment Selection Screen by clicking the “Fall Ended” button.

And with that said, I hope you’ll enjoy what we’ve released today. Thank you so much for waiting 💕

notes.title: Our Life: Now & Forever Demo Update Coming Fall 2023!
notes.notes:
Hey everybody!

Our Life: Now & Forever is fully in development now that we’ve finished the final DLC for Our Life: Beginnings & Always. Step 1 is coming along well, and we’ll be able to release another demo expansion before the end of the year.

In late September or early October, we’ll be updating the current demo build with various improvements and even more scenes to play. The plan is to have the entire Step 1 prologue, one Step 1 Moment, plus a small preview into Step 2. 

The way Our Life: Now & Forever works is that it’s divided into four time periods, what we call “Steps”. Step 1 is childhood, Step 2 is adolescence, Step 3 is young adulthood, and Step 4 is adulthood. Steps 1, 2, and 3 have a prologue, five free Moments, five optional DLC Moments, and a conclusion. “Moments” are individual stories that can be played in any order you want or skipped entirely. Step 4 is an epilogue and isn’t broken up into different Moments. It’s one long story.

We’d like the demo to give a fuller picture of the game experience by including a complete prologue, a full Moment, and letting players see what the changing of the Step is like. Currently, the demo only includes a partial look into the Step 1 prologue. So, this upcoming expansion will make a big difference to the experience.

We’ve also created new bio images for the two leads for Step 1 and Step 2. They’re quite pretty!

notes.title: Our Life: Now & Forever Demo Expansion & Store Page Update ✨
notes.notes:
The Our Life Now & Forever Demo has been updated!

Thank you to everyone who has been looking forward to this. If you've played the demo before, here's a quick rundown of what's new; 25,000 more words, new MC doll accessories, the 'create your own MC bio' feature, sound effects through all scenes, plus other small tweaks and improvements.

Besides the build itself, the store page was remade to feature new promotional art, screenshots, and an improved description. Progress and polish for the game are coming along very well 💕.

[b]Game Premise:[/b]

Fall settles over the charming mountain town of Golden Grove as the story begins. But it isn't only glittering leaves that are changing. You and your mom leave behind everything you knew before when you move to a new home nestled right in the middle of a tight knit cul-de-sac. It’s there where a paper airplane lands at your feet and brings you to unanticipated crossroads.

Make your own path through life as you grow from childhood to adulthood with your two closest neighbors. Even in the chilly autumn weather, it’ll be a truly heartwarming time.

[b]Demo Features:[/b]

    -A 75,000-word script and dozens of choices to make
    -Design your own MC in terms of appearance, identity, personality, and preferences
    -Make a personalized bio image for your MC that can be saved and shared
    -Develop your own custom dynamic with the two leads
    -Customize the font style and textbox arrangement to suit your preferences
    -Enjoy a music room to listen to the OST at your leisure 

Thanks again for waiting for the update. It's been great seeing how excited people are to spend more time in the town of Golden Grove. I hope you have a wonderful afternoon there in these new scenes!

notes.title: Our Life: Now & Forever Demo Update! 🎊
notes.notes:
We're finally ready to release an expanded version of the demo. It's got twice as much content all around and gives a much better idea of what it'll be like to play the finished version!

[b]Demo Features:[/b]

    -50,000 words and dozens of choices to make (twice as long as the prior demo)
    -Design your own MC (with even more options than before)
    -Customize your mom to match your character (with more options than before)
    -Choose a cute sticker to tell different playthroughs apart (with more options than before)
    -Develop your own custom dynamic with the two leads (and in this demo you can start seeing the impacts of those decisions)
    -A music room to listen to the OST at your leisure (a new feature in this updated version) 

It's been great seeing things shape up more and more. I really hope you'll enjoy the demo if you give it a try!
